thread:
alex: Heads-up: I'm about to push a minor change to /v1/rerank that introduces two optional fields: rank_id (string) and score_meta (map). Need quick sign-off on backward-compat behavior and canary plan. Summary below.

maria: What's score_meta intended for? examples?

alex: Used for downstream explainability — small JSON with provenance tags like {"model":"v3","calibrated":true}. We'll treat it as an opaque JSON string in logs. Not used for ranking math.

cheng: So tie-breaker logic? Are we changing anything about ordering?

alex: No change to primary sort (numeric score desc). Tie-breaker will be: 1) numeric score desc, 2) if equal or both null -> stable_hash(rank_id || candidate_id || request_id) asc. If rank_id provided it's the primary tie key; otherwise fallback to candidate_id. Null scores are treated as -Infinity for ordering (i.e., push to end). We'll derive the stable hash as HMAC-SHA256(request_id, "rerank-seed-v1").

sam: SDKs will need to accept optional rank_id and pass-through score_meta. Are we bumping a minor version?

tia: Also can we support a canary header like X-Rerank-Canary: rollout-2026-03 so clients can opt-in server-side? Need unit test vectors too.

alex: Yes to both. I'll add header support and a set of canonical test vectors for tie cases and nulls. Example request/response below.

alex: ```json
{
  "request_id": "req-12345",
  "model": "rerank-v3",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "features": {...}, "score": 0.82, "rank_id": "rA"},
    {"id": "c2", "features": {...}, "score": 0.82},
    {"id": "c3", "features": {...}, "score": null}
  ],
  "headers": {"X-Rerank-Canary": "rollout-2026-03"}
}
```

alex: ```json
{
  "request_id": "req-12345",
  "results": [
    {"id": "c1", "score": 0.82},
    {"id": "c2", "score": 0.82},
    {"id": "c3", "score": null}
  ],
  "debug": {"tie_breaks": ["rank_id_present", "stable_hash"]}
}
```

deploy-bot: CI: rerank unit tests failing on python SDK (test_tie_break_seed) — build #4321 :warning:

maria: I'll take test ownership, will reproduce locally. Also - recommend we add an optional debug field in responses when ?debug=true: "tie_break_reason" with values like "rank_id_present" or "stable_hash" so clients can trace.

alex: :thumbsup: Good idea — debug only. We'll gate it behind a query param.

cheng: Rollout plan proposal: canary 5% traffic for 24h. If latency delta > 5ms or correctness diffs (rank order differences vs reference) > 0.2% then auto rollback. Also run offline rerank diffs against historical queries.

sam: I'll land SDK PRs behind a feature flag and update changelogs. Pinging @eng-qa for regression jobs.

tia: Quick CR note: prefer HMAC-SHA256 with canonicalization (sorted keys for any concatenation) instead of raw concat to avoid ambiguity.

alex: Ack — switching to HMAC-SHA256(request_id, "rerank-seed-v1") and canonicalize candidate id form.

maria: No blockers from ML side. We'll validate calibration metadata in score_meta but won't use it for sorting.

sam: FYI I'll bump SDK minor versions and include the canary header helper.

alex: Merging PR in ~2h unless objections. Leaving a TODO to add 10 deterministic test vectors + a small script to compute tie hashes so SDKs can replicate. Thanks everyone :rocket:
